name: Rapid Depressurization
source: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World
description: A stray shot shatters a window, sucking out the room's precious atmosphere.
disable: DC 14 Crafting (trained) or Labor Lore|dc:14 (trained) while adjacent to the window to patch the hole, DC 16 Computers (trained) to activate an emergency metal shutter from any console in the room, or DC 18 Survival or DC 18 Thievery to cover the hole (if adjacent) with a random object as a temporary fix.
reset: 1 minute after a depressurization hazard begins, all air escapes from area F (requiring living creatures to activate their environmental protections or begin suffocating). If the hazard is disabled before 1 minute has passed, this timer resets.

defensiveAbilities.name: Blow Out
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A ranged attack critically fails

Effect All corporeal creatures inside area F are Suppressed until the hazard is disabled or 1 minute has passed.
